views.label: All
views.note: chi routes into the hexagon; pgxpool hides behind PgBouncer, Redis rides go-redis, River powers cmd/worker — Docker images on Kubernetes.

views.label: Auth
views.note: Signup, verify and login ride the slices; codes and sessions persist in Postgres through PgBouncer, access JWTs never leave the response.

views.label: Realtime
views.note: WS /api/v1/ws?token= closes 4001 on a bad token; SSE flushes per write and dies with the request; cache reads ride go-redis.

views.label: Ops
views.note: readyz pings the pool; golang-migrate runs as a deploy step, never startup; cmd/worker runs the River client and drains jobs on SIGTERM.

boundaries.label: The <app> runtime — Docker images on Kubernetes
State plane — the only persistence boundary

cards.title: The three skills
items: skills/go-best-practices loads on every Go edit and carries the stack contract digest (references/backend-go-stack.md)
skills/go-review writes a prioritized report where every finding cites the rule it breaks and shows the fix
skills/go-port ports any language to idiomatic Go, porting the original tests first so behavior is provable

cards.title: The stack it teaches
items: chi is the router: go-chi/chi/v5 mounts the same method + wildcard patterns (POST /api/v1/widgets/{id}) — the ServeMux shape carried by chi.URLParam; gin/echo are acceptable alternatives, fiber only for throughput-critical gateways
pgx/v5 + pgxpool is built once at the composition root and hides behind PgBouncer transaction pooling; cache traffic rides go-redis over the Dragonfly-compatible protocol
golang-migrate applies reversible migrations as a deploy step — never at server startup (readyz catches drift); goose is the sanctioned alternative

cards.title: Jobs, observability, deploy
items: durable email/webhook delivery runs on River: river.AddTx inside the same Postgres transaction, retries with backoff, unique + periodic schedules — the hand-rolled outbox drain is what you must NOT build yourself

OpenTelemetry is required — otelhttp wraps the mux at the chain head — and Prometheus serves /metrics; google/wire wires cmd/api, go-playground/validator checks DTOs at http.go; slog (zap alt) is the only logging dep
one Docker image, two Deployments, Kubernetes under the edge proxy; slog keeps request_id from the middleware, never domain.go
